item.title: [infoq] TikTok SRE 技术负责人：AI Agents 说到底就是分布式系统
item.description: At a recent talk, TikTok SRE tech lead Salman Munaf explained that AI agents become distributed systems once they start calling external services. A refund API timeout is a good example: timeout means 'unknown', not failure, so retrying without idempotency keys or status lookup can execute the same refund twice. He recommends treating agent memory as invalidatable cache and logging what the agent saw, did, and why.

item.title: [v2ex] [OpenAI] OAI、AAI、与 NS 方程
item.description: OpenAI announced that a multi-agent system powered by its next-generation model has completed a proof for the Navier-Stokes millennium problem — the roughly 90-year-old question of whether 3D fluid equations can develop singularities, one of the Clay Mathematics Institute’s seven Millennium Prize Problems. OpenAI says the proof was done collaboratively by agents and that the model is significantly stronger than GPT-6Astra. Several researchers are already disputing the credit.

Generating becomes a reusable step rather than a dead-end download, and creators doing product films, character shorts, or storyboards can keep iterating on the same footage.
